pages.text: Sample Vault: 54-slot storage for life samples only, auto-merging same source+purity.$(br)Place within 3 blocks of analyzer/potion table for linked access.
Organ Vault: 9 pages x 9 slots + 9 stash, organs auto-sorted by body slot.$(br)Consumes 1 Life Energy per tick to keep organs active.
Potion Cabinet: 54-slot storage for potions, merging same template+purity with template filter.$(br)Place within 3 blocks of the potion table.
